import cftime

from xarray.coding.cftimeindex import CFTimeIndex
from xarray.core.resample_cftime import CFTimeGrouper


class TestCFTimeBinConditionSnapshotHardQA:
    def test_cftime_bin_condition_snapshot_case(self) -> None:
        index = CFTimeIndex(
            [
                cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001, 1, 1, 6),
                cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001, 1, 1, 18),
                cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001, 1, 2, 6),
                cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001, 1, 2, 18),
                cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001, 1, 3, 6),
                cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001, 1, 3, 18),
                cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001, 1, 4, 6),
            ]
        )

        grouper = CFTimeGrouper(
            freq="2D",
            closed="left",
            label="left",
            origin="start_day",
            offset="12h",
        )
        first_items, codes = grouper.first_items(index)

        assert len(codes) == len(index)
        assert first_items.size > 0

import cftime
from xarray.coding.cftimeindex import CFTimeIndex
from xarray.core.resample_cftime import CFTimeGrouper, _get_time_bins

index = CFTimeIndex([
    cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001,1,1,6),
    cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001,1,1,18),
    cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001,1,2,6),
    cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001,1,2,18),
    cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001,1,3,6),
    cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001,1,3,18),
    cftime.DatetimeNoLeap(2001,1,4,6),
])

grouper = CFTimeGrouper(freq='2D', closed='left', label='left', origin='start_day', offset='12h')

datetime_bins, labels = _get_time_bins(index, grouper.freq, grouper.closed, grouper.label, grouper.origin, grouper.offset)
print('index_last', index[-1], type(index[-1]))
print('bin_last', datetime_bins[-1], type(datetime_bins[-1]))
print('condition', index[-1] > datetime_bins[-1])

# also run first_items to ensure same path
fi,codes = grouper.first_items(index)
print('ok', len(codes), fi.size)
PY
